firm_data.firm_description: The Coppola Firm serves individuals, businesses, and organizations through Buffalo and New York State. They handle business law, employment law, and personal injury cases.
notable_facts: Lisa Coppola was previously a partner at Hodgson Russ and was the first female litigator named equity partner there.
Lisa Coppola authored the New York-compliant, online sexual harassment training at coppolatrainings.com.

email.subject: AI for The Coppola Firm, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Lisa,

Your track record breaking through at Hodgson Russ as the first female litigator named equity partner tells me you know how to compete at the highest level. That same drive to outperform is exactly what we're seeing from Buffalo and upstate firms handling complex employment and business disputes.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're expanding into New York. I'd be happy to stop by your office to show how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping firms like yours compete with BigLaw on employment and commercial work.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
